Summary Candidates should listen to the recording very carefully and develop techniques and strategies to enable them to identify and select appropriate details for their answers. There is a need to work on emerging Hindi vocabulary to access some questions and also to focus on sounds and letters, paying particular attention to similar-sounding letters. Teachers should also try dictation activities with their candidates regularly in class. Candidates should gain as much practice as possible at listening exercises or news in class and attempt past papers under timed conditions. All this would certainly help to raise the overall standard. HINDI AS A SECOND LANGUAGE
